kind: owner budget approval and sequential network runtime amendment
authority: Owner authorizes Sonnet after gpt-6.1-sol, one cell at a time, ten healthy provider probes thirty seconds apart, two concurrent paid calls, missing-only recovery, TEST once. USD 60 includes holds.
appliesTo: both contestants, all new continuation calls; ten existing answers preserved
order: original sealed item set, logical request identity and order of record unchanged
runtime: native Claude CLI model alias sonnet, medium effort, empty execution folder, minimal system, max output 8192 tokens; same frozen transport
network: Ten consecutive healthy provider probes spaced thirty seconds apart. Two concurrent paid calls, one model cell at a time. Three consecutive connection failures pause ten minutes and repeat the gate.
retryPolicy: No-answer transport failures retry missing-only without limit. Never resend an answered request, including unparsed answers and provider blocks. Preserve receipts and unknown-cost holds; release only proven zero-token/no-output rejections.
providerBlocks: Own column per contestant. Whole blocked item counts as error for blocked contestant, same rule for both. Secondary excludes union of blocked items for both.
resultPolicy: Original TIE-only registration retained. No final sealed result with transport-missing items.
responseClassificationClarification: An explicit native CLI API Error banner with zero output tokens and connection/quota/server failure is no-answer transport. Its raw receipt and known cost remain saved. Content blocks and any generated output remain terminal judge results. No prompt, setting or request changes.
sessionLimitPolicy: An explicit native session or usage limit with zero generated tokens is no-answer provider rejection, never a judge failure. Wait ten minutes, repeat provider gate, then missing-only. Any generated answer remains terminal.

capAmendment.approval: Lead message: "Approved: raise the Sonnet cell cap to 67 USD, recorded as an amendment like the earlier ones. It fits well inside the owner's 1,000 USD total budget."
capAmendment.reason: Pre-TEST gate projected USD 66.5357682 including all prior costs and holds, above USD 60. No TEST request existed at this amendment.
capAmendment.unchanged: Prompts, inputs, model, medium effort, 8192 output cap, cache-off, sealed TEST ids and order, judge contract, provider-block scoring, TIE-only registration.
